normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter has no independent semantics outside _transfer and should be folded into it.
The to parameter exists only as an argument of _transfer and should be merged into it.
The amount parameter is a local binding of _transfer's argument and should be merged into it.
The sender parameter is only meaningful inside _transferStandard.
The recipient parameter is only meaningful inside _transferStandard.
The tAmount parameter is a local binding of _transferStandard.
The tokenAmount parameter only exists as an argument of swapTokensForEth.
The amount parameter of sendETHToFee is a temporary alias for the forwarded ETH value.
The bots_ array is consumed only by the nonosquare loop.
The notbot address is a direct alias of the blacklist write in delBot.
The percentage parameter is only used to recompute _maxTxAmount.
The onoff boolean is a direct alias of the cooldownEnabled assignment.
The local rate is a temporary used by _takeTeam when crediting the team fee.
The contract token balance is a temporary of _transfer used for the swap trigger.
The contract ETH balance is a temporary of _transfer used to gate the fee send.
The path array is a temporary construction local to swapTokensForEth.
